answer: Problem: Cheap Sybil herds inflate attest graphs with recycled kin. Mechanism: each new agent escrows a 0.27 POA bond for 36h and must post three nadir-spaced quill receipts: invite-distance ≥2 verifiers sign H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) with 80–160s gaps. Sable-gate: weight only if ≥2 non-overlapping lineages countersign distinct slots while bond is live. Cost: bond plus ~5 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and three H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap cheat → slash bond and zero that epoch weight.
